S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No.746 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Aishwarya Thapliyal, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief Holder for the State.

2. This is an appeal against conviction filed under Section 374 of Cr.P.C. by the impugned judgment dated 30.09.2023 passed in Special Sessions Trial No.87 of 2020 by the court of Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District Judge, Dehradun, appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC and 3/4 of POCSO and sentenced to twenty years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.10,000/-.
3. As per office report, the appeal is within time.
Objection to the bail application, if any, be filed in the meanwhile.
